mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_services (order_id, service_id, service_name, service_category, price, quantity, duration, assigned_resource_id, assigned_resource_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{serviceId}, #{serviceName}, #{serviceCategory}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{duration}, #{assignedResourceId}, #{assignedResourceType}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT os.service_id as serviceId, os.service_name as serviceName, os.service_category as serviceCategory, DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) as statDate, COUNT(*) as orderCount, SUM(os.quantity) as totalQuantity, SUM(os.price * os.quantity) as totalRevenue, AVG(os.price) as avgPrice FROM order_services os JOIN orders o ON os.order_id = o.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY os.service_id, os.service_name, os.service_category, DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) ORDER BY statDate, totalRevenue DESC

SELECT COALESCE(os.assigned_resource_id, o.resource_id) as staffId, COALESCE(r.name, 'Unknown Staff') as staffName, DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) as statDate, COUNT(*) as orderCount, SUM(os.price * os.quantity) as totalRevenue, AVG(4.5) as avgRating, COUNT(*) as ratingCount, 8.0 as workingHours, (COUNT(*) * 10 + 70) as efficiencyScore FROM order_services os JOIN orders o ON os.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN resources r ON COALESCE(os.assigned_resource_id, o.resource_id) = r.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' AND (os.assigned_resource_id IS NOT NULL OR o.resource_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY COALESCE(os.assigned_resource_id, o.resource_id), COALESCE(r.name, 'Unknown Staff'), DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) ORDER BY statDate, totalRevenue DESC
